description: Transvaalbuurt 1908-1914 speculative rows (Transvaalstraat 3-47, Retiefstraat 45-75 and 3-41, Pretoriusstraat 72-120): 5-7 m dark red-brown brick fronts of a 3.8 m ground storey and three 3.15 m upper storeys (five bouwlagen with the attic) under a light simple cornice at 12.8-14.2 m; three axes of tall white-framed windows with a top light, the centre axis a balcony door with an iron-railed projecting balcony on storeys 1-3; over the cornice a pointed brick gable, a brick wall dormer over the centre axis, or a white pointed timber dormer, on a pitched tile roof

match.note: 3DBAG eaves 12-16.6 m and bouwlagen 5 on these rows (the attic counts); the eaves over the type's 3.375 m pitch give 4 storeys, the 1913 three-storey rows of Transvaalstraat 74-104 (9.7 m) 3. BAG 1908-1914 on all 37 photographed faces. No balcony veto (the type has them). Crown by the skyline: a narrow-topped tall crown is a pointed gable (Retiefstraat 45-75, Pretoriusstraat 72-120), a 1-2.8 m flat top a brick wall dormer (Retiefstraat 3-41, 45-51), a small low crown a white timber dormer (Transvaalstraat 3-47, Majubastraat 1-151)

point-gable.note: Retiefstraat 53-75 (154435 136245 092019), Pretoriusstraat 80-96 (102414 149642 142310): a pointed brick gable the width of the front, top 15.5-16.5 m (rise 2.5-3 m over the cornice), one attic light

wall-dormer.note: Retiefstraat 45-51 (068243 123300), Retiefstraat 3-41 (068730 081061): a brick wall dormer over the centre axis, about 1.8 m wide, rising 2.3-2.6 m over the cornice, one light, flat cap

dormer.note: Transvaalstraat 21-41 (072312 084571 149583 108858): one white timber dormer with a pointed cap over the cornice, 1.2-1.6 m wide, top 16.0-16.7 m

door-left.note: the house door (round-arched on Retiefstraat 45-75) on the left axis; mirrored when the strip reads it on the right

rhythm.bays: window, balcony door, window (two axes at 5 m, four or five on the 8.5-10.8 m double fronts)
rhythm.identicalBays: near: the centre balcony door is a little narrower
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + windows | 1-3: window + balcony door + window
rhythm.symmetry: near symmetric; the door side alternates along the row
rhythm.groundFloor: house door on an outer axis, windows or a shop
rhythm.signage: shops on Pretoriusstraat and Transvaalstraat corners
rhythm.roofline: a light simple cornice; a pointed gable, a brick wall dormer or a white dormer over it

the segmental brick relieving arches over the Transvaalstraat windows and the round-arched house doors of Retiefstraat 45-75 are flat heads
the white bands at the sill and head lines of Retiefstraat 45-75 are not drawn
a pointed gable with an attic light is drawn over the whole front; on Retiefstraat 45-75 it covers about two thirds
the 8.5-10.8 m double fronts (two houses under one BAG pand, two dormers) are one module with four or five axes
